spanish: Y su minjá sólet mezclada en el aceite: tres décimos al toro el uno, dos décimos al carnero el uno.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the untranslated lemma minjá; the token licenses a Spanish noun, not a Hebrew loan.
Common noun left as the untranslated lemma sólet; the token licenses a Spanish noun, not a Hebrew loan.

notes: Counts, tenths, passive mix, oil, bull, ram, and each «el uno» match the tokens; «su» fits a singular noun with a 3mp possessor.
